data.title: 篝之雾枝 · 古堡王座上的深红审视
data.description: 幽暗宏大的古堡石质王座厅内，哥特玫瑰彩窗将血月的光芒洒在大理石台阶上。雾枝高踞黑色雕花王座，单手摇晃装满深红酒液的高脚杯，居高临下俯视，女王气场慑人心魄。
data.location: vast gothic castle throne room with towering rose window under crimson blood moon
data.action: seated regally on black carved stone throne, one arm resting on throne arm holding wine goblet, legs crossed, proud commanding smirk
data.lighting: 血月玫瑰窗赤红光与烛台昏黄火影
data.promptProse: Kirie sits atop an ornate black stone throne in her layered gothic gown swirling a wineglass, gazing downward with supreme vampire majesty.
data.animaCaption: Blood-red light through the rose window outlines her throne silhouette as she holds the wine glass.
